adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, line 46 in embeddable-host.js.es6 shows `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { this.sendAction('deleteHost', this.get('host')); });` - this promise chain has no `.catch()` handler. In contrast, the `save()` action on line 38 properly chains `.catch(popupAjaxError)`. If the DELETE request fails, the user won't see any error message and the host will remain in the table without feedback. This is a real bug - inconsistent error handling where save handles errors but delete does not.
